Ranking uses the 95% Wilson lower bound of direction agreement to reduce small-sample luck. Repeated same-direction views on one stock form one 90-day episode; direction changes also wait until the prior 20-session window ends. Unadjusted prices and missing content can bias results. This compares recorded directions, not investment returns or future performance. Related stocks may share market drivers; these samples are not fully independent.

app.social.formula: Rule reddit-attention-v1: volume contributes up to 50 points [50 × min(1, log10(1+mentions)/3)]; growth up to 30 [30 × min(1, max(0, log2(current/prior))/3)]; rank up to 20 [20 × max(0, (26−rank)/25)]. The components sum to an index from 0 to 100.
app.social.threshold: An index requires at least 20 mentions in both windows. “Overheated discussion” requires an index of at least 75, at least 100 mentions, and at least twice the prior count. Other readings of 50 or above are elevated. These initial thresholds have not been validated against returns.
app.social.limits: Coverage is limited to the top 100 in ApeWisdom’s stock-focused communities, not all of Reddit or the market. Repeated symbols within a post or comment count once. Repost, bot and promotion filtering and unique-author counts are unknown. Confidence is limited; bullish or bearish sentiment is unavailable.

The September 4, 2026 close was $10.03, up 70.9%. The first twenty sessions after the announcement, however, returned −22.0%.
walkthrough.cases.glw: Corning: the May 6, 2026 agreement included $500 million in warrants; $180 is the traditional warrant exercise price. The May 6–September 4 period low was $114.50 intraday on July 28. Closing prices fell 15.0% across that period. RSI(14) was 30.7, meeting the example rule of below 35; the indicator is recalculated from closes through that date.
walkthrough.cases.macro: Macro context: the Fed held rates on June 18, 2025. Robinhood’s already-published Q1 results explain its exposure to interest yields. Cryptocurrency revenue growth of 100% year over year adds business context.
